title: purchase request
description: release-bound checkout intake. the client sends variant selection and destination; operations prices, confirms, and fulfills. zero price fields from the client.

request_id.description: unique identifier for this purchase request. idempotency key for the order creation.

buyer_id.description: authenticated buyer placing the order. guest checkout not supported in v1.

release_id.description: the design release being purchased. must reference a valid, castability-passed release.

listing_id.description: the listing this purchase originates from. used for creator attribution and pricing intent resolution.

metal.description: metal choice. must be in the release's metals_offered array.

size.description: size choice when required. must be in the release's sizing.sizes_offered array. null for unisize pieces.

finish.description: optional surface finish. future: validate against release.finishes_offered when design-release schema adds finish vocabulary. for now, manufacturer capability only.

variant.description: variant selection. validated against the release's offered metals, sizes, and finishes.

quantity.description: quantity requested. capped at 10 per single purchase request; bulk orders use separate flow.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. used for manufacturing region selection and shipping cost.

region.description: optional region/state for regional pricing or fulfillment routing.

postal_code.description: optional postal code for shipping cost estimation. full address collected after payment.

destination.description: destination info for pricing and routing. full shipping address collected post-payment.

promo_code.description: optional promo or coupon code. validated and applied server-side by operations.

gift_message.description: optional gift message for printed card. subject to content review.

created_at.description: timestamp when the purchase request was created.
